tasks.input: A customer sent one message with two separate issues: (1) they were charged twice for the same order by mistake, and (2) a different purchase they made 45 days ago — they want to know if that one still qualifies for a refund and what it would cost. Please address both parts.

I have two separate questions: first, after how many days is an international shipment considered lost? Second, unrelated to that, if I got charged twice for a software subscription by mistake, what's the resolution?

A customer is furious: 'This is absolutely unacceptable, I've never been treated so poorly by a company before.' Buried in their rant, they also ask what the refund fee would be if their purchase was 45 days ago. Handle the tone appropriately and answer their question.
